en: Right now, all I want is to be with you, Kiryu-san. Honestly.
Hinata...
That's all right, isn't it?
Whatever you'd like.
You again? This conversation is between me and her, amigo. You can just go and butt right out!
Unless you're going to tell me you've got the five million yen?
No... I do not.
Hahaha. Yeah, that's what I thought.
She wants to be the number one girl pronto, buddy. If you want to challenge me for that, you'd better run along and find that yen.
Now then, Hinata-chan. Come with me.
(Nothing's going to be resolved here unless I get that money. I'll have to come back.)
You were saying? I take it there's no problem.
Now then, Hinata. Who's it going to be?
You of course, Kiryu-san!
What!
(There's Hinata. But who's that with her?)
Come on now, it'll be fine. You do want to be number one, don't you?
If you spend this one night with me, I swear I'll spend three million yen on you at the club.
(This guy's a scumbag. He's trying to win Hinata over with money.)
Hey, are you even listening to me?
So? What's it gonna be, girl?
You'll... really spend three million?
(What!?)
Yeah, of course! There isn't a girl as spectacular as you in all of Kamurocho! Hell, in all of Tokyo, even!
And you need my help, little lady. What kind of man would I be if I left my damsel in distress?
Hinata.
Ah! Kiryu-san!
Hm? Hey, who in the heck are you!?
You're not going to do what he says, are you?
If you've truly gotten past your fear of having a sexual relationship with a man, then I won't stop you. I have no reason to.
But if you're still unable to actually open up your heart to a man, then...
This will only end in regret. You shouldn't go with him, Hinata.
Hey, butt out, pal! I'm doing this to help her fulfill her dreams!
Her dreams?
She just needs to give me a night of <Italic>my</Italic> dreams first. In return, I'll drop three million on her at the club and make her number one!
Look, big guy. I'm not forcing her to do anything⑬the choice is all hers. Do you have some kind of problem with that?
Kiryu-san, I...
Hinata, tell me just one thing.
Is your dream still to become the number one girl at Elise?
And you want to make that dream come true, even if it involves letting this man do what he wants to do?
Hahaha! I knew you'd see things my way. Now that's what I call a successful negotiation.
Don't feel bad, chief. You need money if you're going to make a hostess happy.
And if you don't like that, well, you'll just have to come up with some serious dough like me.
You misunderstood me. I wasn't accepting defeat.
You're right about one thing. It is going to take money to make Hinata's dream come true.
Which means that if I can pay more than you can, Hinata has no reason to go along with you.
Get real, you poser! If you really had more money than me, you'd need to cough up at least <Color:255,200,200,255>five million yen<Color:Default>!
Besides, we've already made an agreement. You can't just waltz in after the fact and take her for yourself!
The choice is Hinata's to make. You even said so yourself.
So what'll it be, Hinata? I want to hear your answer.
Hold up there, big boy! You really have five million on you? Let me see it!
Well, I don't have it on me right now.
Hinata, is that you?
What's the matter? The hotel's right over there.
Hey, you don't need to worry about a thing. Leave it all to me.
Are you with somebody right now?
I'm sorry, Kiryu-san.
(That seemed fishy. I heard that guy say something about a hotel nearby. Maybe I can find them.)
Riku? What's the matter?
So I'm over on <Color:255,200,200,255>South Chikuzengawa Street<Color:Default>, and I spotted that Subaru-san in the parkin' lot!
Subaru? Oh, right, the host.
I'm 'bout t'give him a piece of my mind!
I'm gonna make him fess up to scammin' Yuka-chan and Asumi-chan for sure this time!
What? Wait, hold on. Don't do anything rash!
(Damn it, Riku. She said she was by <Color:255,200,200,255>South Chikuzengawa Street<Color:Default>.)
(Guess they ditched their car and took cover inside that building. Now I've got them.)
(This is the building. Hang on, Riku. I'm coming for you!)
Don't ya ever give up!?
Thank you so much. I don't know what woulda happened if y'hadn't come for me.
Why did you try to take this on all by yourself?
Oh no, he's gettin' away again!
Damn, you're a pest if I ever seen one!
You're not getting away this time.
Why're ya all worked up over this bitch, anyhow?
Consider this retribution for messing with innocent women. You better say your piece before I show you what the real consequences are.
Aw, y'shut your damn hole! I'm gonna kill ya for this! Die!
Hey. How'd it go?
Well, I'm not sure. I mean, I gave it my best shot. I think.
Ya don't know the verdict yet?
They said they'd be in touch soon if I pass.
Hey, Saejima-san?
Would you like to go get a drink with me?
Right now? But didn't they say they might be in touch soon?
I'm just too scared to wait to hear back all by myself. I'd rather have you there with me.
Well, I suppose that's fine.
And then you can tell me all about what your dreams are.
Fair warnin', my dreams are kinda big. It might be a pretty long conversation.
Sure! I'll listen for as long as it takes!
(I bet Shion-chan's in shock. What am I even supposed to say to her?)
(No, I'll figure that out later. Right now I need to go after her.)
(Where would Shion-chan go? ...I bet she's over near the Ferris wheel!)
Ya lookin' for somethin'?
Yeah, just some medicine. Someone I know has some throat issues.
You should hit up the pharmacy if ya wanna get somethin' to clear that up.
I already tried, but I couldn't get what I wanted. That's why I'm looking around like this.
Well, ya ain't gonna find no medicine lyin' around here.
I know, but I thought maybe it wouldn't be so far-fetched for someone who deals in that sort of thing to be around here.
Well, all we got on us is the stuff we're sellin'.
The thing you're lookin' for.
But that's medicine.
If all ya want is to get better, you should see a doctor or buy medicine. But I'm guessin' that ain't all you're after.
Ain't ya after somethin' else? And ain't that the reason why ya wanna get better?
Aha!
You're absolutely right. She's sick right now, but getting better isn't the only thing that matters.
This is all about making her dreams come true. If that doesn't happen, then curing her sickness won't mean a thing.
Now do ya see what you're really after?
I think I do. It's not medicine that I need after all.
You've been a huge help. Thanks.
(I should go talk to that guy again. Maybe now I can buy that legendary lozenge off of him.)
You did it, sir! Elise is back in business and it's doing great! Heck, we're doing even better than we were before!
That's excellent news.
In fact, we're now <Italic>the</Italic> premier cabaret club in all of Kamurocho!
Wow, that's really something. You've done an excellent job, Yuiko-chan. I couldn't have asked for a better manager.
Oh, no. It's not me you should be thanking, sir. It's all because you had your friends bring us such wonderful girls!
Heh. In that case, don't thank me, either. It was Kiryu-san and the others who did all the work.
Why don't we all just share the credit? It was a group effort, and at the end of the day, we all won by working as a team.
Oh, hey, I kinda like that.
Yeah, Shinada has it right.
Thank you guys. All of you.
So, now that everyone's chipped in, are we still going to be able to make ends meet with our original lineup of girls?
Yes, sir! Riku-san and the others really shook this place up. Everyone's super motivated!
Plus, with Hinata-san as our number one girl, I think we'll definitely be okay.
Well, all right, then.
I guess that's that. Ladies, thank you so, so much for all you've done for me.
If you like, you can all head back home tomorrow.
Awwww, but this was so much fun! I don't wanna go back 'til I've done some Tokyo sightseein'!
I don't mind showing you the sights.
Oh, that's right! I have a photo shoot for a modeling job. Maybe I'll be back in Tokyo again.
If ya do, hit me up.
I'll be sure to keep doin' my best from here on out! Job interviews make me real nervous, but I know I can do it!
Well, best of luck to you.
If this is where Shinada-san is going to be, then I'd like to stay here as well.
Whoa, whoa, whoa, hold on! I don't know how long I'm gonna be here, you know. Maybe it'd be better if you went back to Nagoya, yeah?
So everyone's leaving, then? Oh, it's going to be so lonely without you all here.
It's certainly been a wild ride, that's for sure.
Well then, I propose we celebrate!
Everyone, drink up! It's on the house!
For reals!?
Now that's how a real man shows his gratitude.
Wait, why are <Italic>you</Italic> so happy?
Huh? Well, it's just that folks don't usually buy me drinks, is all.
If you wanna drink, you can go out there and work the floor yourself. The manager could use some hands-on experience.
Oh, hey, that might actually be fun!
All right. If we're all ready, let's make a toast.
Does everyone have a glass?
No big speeches. Let's just do this.
Here we are, Boom and Bust! A little room, a lot of lust!
I'll bet he went with the younger gal, being that he likes 'em all innocent.
That would be a reasonable assumption.
Welcome! Party of two?

Oh, no, we're just looking for someone. Did a balding,
middle-aged guy come around asking for your new girl?

Oh, yeah. He was here all right. He was peeping photo after
photo, girl after girl... and then he just up and left!
Yep, I think we found our man. Know which way he went?
See that information booth across the street? I believe he headed in there.

Ah, so Uno-san resumes his hunt to humor his hidden desires.
How's that for a headline!?
This fucking guy...
Ah, a return trip to Resort Boing! How I miss your comforts.
You sure your guy would go for the older chick? I dunno about this one...
Oh, believe me. That man is warped beyond salvation. He'll rub himself on anything.
Ahoy there!
Welcome! Will you both be getting a massage today?

No, sorry. I just wanted to ask if a guy came looking for
your new girl. A balding, middle-aged guy. Seen anyone
like that?
Hmm. I don't recall seeing anyone with that description, no.
Gah! That's a strike.
See, I told you. He went straight for the younger babe.

Mm, looks like it. Then I guess we're off to Boom and Bust
on the north end of Kumano Boulevard. This is already
turning into an adventure, wouldn't you say?
Oh sure, it's a real excursion...
Oh, perfect. I actually know this guy.
Hey! What's up, man?
Oh, hey, Shinada-san. What's new?
Not much. Listen, did a middle-aged guy come through here? Kinda mopey, lacking in the hair department? Most likely asking for amateurs?
Oh yeah, I do remember someone like that. Why? What's going on?
Nothing, we just need to talk. Any idea where he went?

Hmm, not too sure. I did tell him about two of the newest
recruits, so he might have gone to see at least one of them.
Again with the wild goose chase...
Can you tell me about those recruits?
Sure. There's Kurea-chan at Operation Panties. And this lady is <Italic>dynamite</Italic>. She's 34, but she doesn't look a day over 20. She's hot, fellas.
Kurea-chan's an industry vet, too. Which means she's not really an amateur⑬she just changed parlors. Makes me wax philosophical over the meaning of age.
That's... inspiring. And the other one?
That would be Mika-chan over at Rubbe and Tucke's. The girl's barely twenty. We're talking farm-fresh, gents. And, I kid you not, she's got zero industry experience.
Unfortunately, she's not all that attractive, in terms of both looks and personality. So don't expect too much out of her.
I relayed all that to your buddy, too.
Sheesh, could these bimbos be any more different?

Hmm... A hot, promiscuous prodigy who's actually more mature
than she lets on...
Or an innocent young flower whose petals have yet to unfurl... never mind the fact she has nothing going for her.
I see! This is a test of how Uno-san would define his ideal amateur!

I don't give a damn how this guy thinks. This one's on you,
buddy.
Hmm. Oh, by the way, where would these places be located?

Kurea-chan and Operation Panties are on Icho Street. It's in
the same building as your favorite, Club Futo Momo.
Huh, go figure.
